scopeLimitations: baselineSourceRevision records the original wire metadata and writer evidence. Inventory covers Runtime source contracts and Tests/Runtime/Serialization/ConsumerMigration declarations with WALLSTOP_PROTO and UNITY_5_3_OR_NEWER.
Metadata and signatures are frozen, not arbitrary constructor/hook/formatter implementation bodies or runtime model registrations.

capabilities.claim: Both oracles and WProto write identical field bytes for retained readonly geometry shapes.
Closed generic range contracts retain field numbers and scalar omission.
Nullable wrappers retain absence versus present default.
WProto packs scalar lists; the legacy writer need not pack. Matching output bytes are not required.
Declared leaf and base encode through the same subtype envelope.
Root marshal reads the legacy wrapper contract; member encoding remains separate.
Legacy oracle reads the generated root marshal payload.
Retained runtime-model migration payloads combine generic identifiers, inheritance, surrogate values, and explicit defaults. These are representative shapes, not complete consumer deployments.
Explicit default migration has literal goldens and a changed-default control.
An unpacked writer policy accepts interleaved packed and unpacked enum runs.

The v2 model cannot reliably prepare a struct-valued map after model freezing. Its retained 12020807 golden is decoded directly; v3 uses the live oracle. This is not a claim that v2 execution passed for that shape.
A served corrupt payload throws from WProtoFacade.TryDeserialize; false means no serving formatter.
Replacing a formatter after generic resolution changes subsequent operations.
Zero enum key with zero double value writes 32020800. v2 writes 320B0800110000000000000000; both readers accept current output.
Source generation requires partial contract declarations; the diagnostic remains a named regression.
A contract nested inside a generic containing type is refused with a diagnostic.
